title: WHO YOU CHOOSE NEXT
goal: Keep a disturbing thought separate from identity and let the next chosen action represent you instead.

steps.text: Catch the thought without explaining it.
Say, “My mind produced this; it is not my biography.”
Name one value you want to stand for in the next minute—kind, honest, patient, careful, brave, or another word that fits.
Do one ten-second action that matches that principle.
Leave the thought unanswered and continue with the action.

win: A value was named and a ten-second action expressed it while the thought remained unanswered.
mindBend: Identity is better inferred from repeated chosen behaviour than from involuntary mental content. What appears in the mind is not a biography.
